retry_tests.implementation_note: Pure decision logic lives in src/lib/nurture-retry.ts (no DB), wired into src/app/api/internal/nurture/route.ts via candidatesForStep (now LEFT JOINs lead_nurture_log and admits a retriable row: message_id IS NULL, attempt_count = 1, sent_at older than 60 minutes), claimStep (INSERT for a fresh claim, guarded UPDATE for a retry claim), and recordFailure (increments attempt_count; sets message_id = 'send_failed' once attempt_count reaches NURTURE_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 2). MAX_LEAD_AGE_DAYS (45) continues to gate candidatesForStep via l.created_at, so aged-out leads are never retried. Route-level integration was not exercised against a live database in this session.
